## Specific task description

Task instruction: Hold the gray kitchenpot with rounded edges firmly and lift it

Task description: The target is the gray rounded pot in the center of the table, with a lid and handles on both sides. Hold it securely with both hands, lift it, and keep it mostly upright.

Success criteria: The left and right grippers must securely grasp the corresponding grip regions on the pot's left and right sides, lifting it clearly off the table and holding it suspended. Keep the opening upward and the body approximately upright.

## Execution tips

- Prefer the middle of the straight outer sections of the two handles, away from the pot wall. Place the pads on the straight sections and avoid the roots and bends to reduce contact with the pot or an insecure grasp.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the rod thickness. Before closing, confirm both fingers are on opposite sides and enclose the rod effectively, rather than inferring a grasp from image overlap alone.
- When both hands support the load, lift them in sync and keep the handle heights similar to avoid tilting the pot or slipping one handle by lifting one side first.
